data.name: Vibhas
data.long_meaning: Vibhas means 'blessings' or 'prosperity' in Hinduism. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vibhāva', which means 'expansion' or 'manifestation'. The name is often used to signify abundance and success in life.

This name reminds us of the blessings of the gods and the importance of living a prosperous life filled with blessings.
